status: Accepted native Local startup failure display and Copy on the pinned Windows 0.17.27 cohort

cohort.producer: Public signed Windows ARM64 portable GUI, verified with native Authenticode before execution
cohort.window_observation: Existing Windows Interactive Session 1 task and application-window module through ReadLine SSH

workflow.profile: One isolated persistent Local profile with a deliberately nonexistent public executable

copied_typed_snapshot.attribution: The Windows clipboard owner HWND was null. The typed reader verified the exact signed source, the bound foreground window and the advanced sequence.

independent_startup_evidence: The retained application tail recorded the public startup failure. A separate lifecycle journal recorded a startup child exit with code 1 on actor PID 4220.
first_observations_retained: The first stock Observe emitted two OEM-encoded middle dots. The complete lossless decode passed both OEM round-trip checks and stock schema validation.
Earlier stock screenshot and direct-row attempts returned Parallels invalid-argument errors and no native result. The popup Connect action refused hit ownership before input.

In the first keyboard run that reached the Copy control, a stale test supervisor action hash stopped clipboard arming before the reader ran. A fresh run with the corrected pins completed the one Copy and typed read.

helper_followup.scope: The separate Windows helper UTF-8 output fix passed CI and was not deployed in this run.

limits: Covers the pinned Windows ARM64 0.17.27 Local failure and Copy. Same-tab Inspector reopen, other failure categories and other builds remain outside the observed scope.
privacy: This record contains finite typed fields and digests only. Full desktop frames, application and lifecycle originals, and clipboard payloads are not published.
